messages.subject: INLA with Google Collab
parts:
Hi,

    I am new to programming in R language. I was trying to run a script developed by one of my peers which utilized INLA - Poisson . The models used are bym, iid. 

When I execute the code, it runs in time-out problem. I tried in google Collab, same issue occurred. I was able to understand it was running on CPU and it required lot of RAM; more than 11GB. 

 I have worked on python language where we use tensorflow/pytorch models to run GPU. Is there any way to make my model run on GPU rather than CPU? I was not able to find the solution. 

Any inputs will be helpful. 

Thanks and Regards
Niranjan
